messages.subject: R/qtl version 1.50
parts:
A new version of R/qtl (1.50) has been released at its website (https://rqtl.org) and on CRAN. Windows and Mac binaries will be available on CRAN within a few days.

The main change is that cim() now includes an addcovar argument for including additional covariates in the model.

Karl Broman
